P.name: Martial Poise
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Kalista''' inputs a {{tt|movement command|Default MB2/right click}} during her {{tip|attack windup|basic attack windup}} or shortly after it completes, or while in cast time of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'', she will {{tip|dash}} in that direction.

'''''Kalista''' {{tt|cannot dash|See notes}} while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}, and she will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
P.description2:
''Martial Poise'''s dash range and speed details:
* Dash range of basic attacks is modified by the tier of '''Kalista's''' [[Boots]] and the angle of the dash.
** At a 0° angle towards the target, the minimum dash range is {{pp|140;153;166;175|None;Basic;Finished;Tier-3|type=Boots Tier}} units.
** At a 90° angle, the maximum dash range is {{pp|240;263;280;300|None;Basic;Finished;Tier-3|type=Boots Tier}} units.
* Dash range of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' is 300 units when dashing anywhere in the direction of the point of cast.
** If the dash is inputted to a location that is ''away'' from ''{{ais|Pierce|Kalista}}'' point of cast, the dash range is reduced based on the angle, with a minimum distance of 150 units if the inputted location is {{tt|directly opposite|Backwards dash}}.
* Dash speed is increased based on the {{tt|tier|+75 for Boots and +135 for finished Boots}} of '''Kalista's''' [[Boots]], and is affected by her {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} as well as {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} modifiers she is under the effect of (including {{tip|slow|slows}}).
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Oathsworn Bond:}} '''Kalista''' begins the game with an exclusive ''{{ii|Black Spear}}'' that she can activate on an allied champion to deem them ''Oathsworn'', forming a {{tip|tether}} together. While she and the ally bound as the ''Oathsworn'' are within tether range of each other, they can both interact with ''{{ai|Sentinel 3|Kalista|Soul-Mark}}'' and ''{{ai|Fate's Call|Kalista}}''.
P.description4: '''''Kalista''' can purchase the {{ii|Black Spear}} from the [[shop]] at no cost to obtain it again and, before 3 minutes of game time, may activate the item again on a different target to designate a new Oathsworn. See {{ii|Black Spear}} for more details.''

Q.name: Pierce
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' launches a spear in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.description2: If ''Pierce'' kills the target, the spear continues onward to transfer all of the target's ''{{ai|Rend|Kalista}}'' stacks to the next enemy it hits.

W.name: Sentinel
W.description: {{sbc|Passive - Soul-Marked:}} While '''Kalista''' and her ''{{ii|The Black Spear|Oathsworn}}'' are {{tip|tether|tethered}}, their basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' apply a ''Soul-Mark'' to the target hit for 4 seconds.
W.description2: If both '''Kalista's''' and the ''Oathsworn's'' ''Soul-Mark'' are applied to the same enemy, the marks are consumed to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target, capped against non-champions. ''Soul-Mark'' cannot affect an enemy more than once every few seconds.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|10 to 18}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
{{st|Maximum Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}}}}
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' summons a ''Sentinel'' that patrols back and forth on a path along the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings as it travels.
W.description4: '''Kalista''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Sentinel'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.

E.name: Rend
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kalista's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rend'' to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 254 times per enemy.
E.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' rips out the lodged spears from all nearby enemies afflicted with ''Rend'' stacks, consuming the stacks on each target to deal {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds. For each stack beyond the first, the target is dealt additional {{as|physical damage}}. ''Rend'' deals 50% damage against epic {{tip|monsters}}.

''Rend's'' cast also empowers the in-flight missiles of '''Kalista's''' basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' to apply ''Rend's'' effects to their targets immediately upon hitting them.
E.description3: If ''Rend'' kills at least one target, its {{sti|cooldown}} is reset and '''Kalista''' restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}.
E.description4: ''A nearby enemy with a Rend stack is required to cast this ability.''

R.name: Fate's Call
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' invokes her {{ii|The Black Spear|tether}} to retrieve and hold her ''Oathsworn'' for 4 seconds. '''Kalista''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} the ''Oathsworn'' from all {{tip|crowd control}} and renders them {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for the duration, and {{tip|dash|pulls}} them to her over 1 second.
R.description2: While held, the ''Oathsworn'' is {{tip|vanish|vanished}} and may {{tt|select|Default MB1 / left-click}} a target location to {{tip|dash}} to with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, ending ''Fate's Call's'' invocation and reappearing at the location. If the invocation ends without the ''Oathsworn'' selecting a target location, they will automatically do so at maximum range from '''Kalista's''' facing direction.
R.description3: The ''Oathsworn's'' dash stops upon colliding with an enemy {{tip|champion}}. Upon the dash ending by collision or arriving to the targeted location, the ''Oathsworn'' {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} all nearby enemies and keeps them {{tip|airborne}} for a set duration, while simultaneously {{tip|lunge|landing}} to their {{sti|attack range|'''base''' attack range}} {{tt|from the closest target hit|See notes}}.
R.description4: ''The Oathsworn must be within tether range to cast this ability, and is also {{tip|silence|silenced}} and unable to perform movement or attack commands while Fate's Call is in effect.''
